Senses.Explanation: Hall discourses place the paired bareness beside having nothing to grasp, before birth and after birth, or as a view that itself still requires examination. All witnesses retain the two coordinated bareness terms, often beside nothing to grasp or no covering left, rather than treating either reduplication alone as the formula.
